summary.zh: 收紧 Marketplace 所有者权限与诊断隐私，避免旧安装入口绕过原生签名生命周期，并保护完整激活配置。
summary.en: Tightens Marketplace owner authorization and diagnostic privacy, prevents legacy install routes from bypassing the signed native lifecycle, and protects complete activation configuration.

title.zh: 收紧 Marketplace 权限与配置保护
title.en: Harden Marketplace authority and configuration protection

summary.zh: Marketplace 诊断现在按所有者权限统一裁剪，旧原生安装入口仅限 Studio 所有者，缺少完整 activations 快照时界面会拒绝写入。
summary.en: Marketplace diagnostics are now consistently projected by owner authority, the legacy native install route is restricted to Studio owners, and Settings refuse writes without a complete activations snapshot.

details.zh: 远程或非所有者响应不再泄露来源、激活映射、Claude 绑定输入或本地路径。
details.en: Remote or non-owner responses no longer expose sources, activation maps, Claude binding inputs, or local paths.

details.zh: Agent 原生安装仍明确引导到 Settings 中的签名计划与执行流程。
details.en: Agent native-install requests continue to direct owners to the signed plan-and-execute flow in Settings.
